AvatarConfigRequest.description: Save hero-forge customization: skin, hair, outfit, headgear, weapon, pet
AvatarConfigRequest.title: AvatarConfigRequest

BattleAnswerResponse.description: The graded result of one answer: correct answer, explanation, damage both ways, taunt and the new state.
BattleAnswerResponse.title: BattleAnswerResponse

BattleCreateRequest.description: Start (or resume) a server-side boss fight on one of the user's documents.
BattleCreateRequest.title: BattleCreateRequest

BattleQuestionResponse.description: The next question (options shuffled by the server, no answer) and the battle's state.
BattleQuestionResponse.title: BattleQuestionResponse

BattleResponse.description: A battle: its boss, hearts, phase, combo and status. Never a correct answer.
BattleResponse.title: BattleResponse

DocumentOut.description: One uploaded PDF. `id` is the session_id every study endpoint takes.
DocumentOut.title: DocumentOut

FlashcardReviewRequest.description: The user flipped a card and says whether they knew it: counts for that concept's mastery.
FlashcardReviewRequest.title: FlashcardReviewRequest

ReviewDeckResponse.description: Flashcards built from the questions the user missed (arena + quiz) on this document - no AI call.
ReviewDeckResponse.title: ReviewDeckResponse

RewardResponse.description: Result of RewardService.award(): ok=false with reason when capped, else the full breakdown.
RewardResponse.title: RewardResponse

RunChooseRequest.description:
Answer the run's pending choice. rest: heal | study (target = concept); shop: buy (target = item id) | leave;
relic offer: take (target = relic id) | skip.
RunChooseRequest.title: RunChooseRequest

RunCreateRequest.description: Start (or resume) an Expedition run through one of the user's documents.
RunCreateRequest.title: RunCreateRequest

RunResponse.description:
An Expedition run: map of the current act, where the player stands and can go, hearts / gold / relics,
the pending choice (if any) and the fight in progress (if any).
RunResponse.title: RunResponse

ShopActionResponse.description: Purchase / equip / unequip: {"ok": bool, "reason"?: str, ...}. Business failures are 200 with ok=false.
ShopActionResponse.title: ShopActionResponse

UploadResponse.description: Returned immediately; indexing continues in the background (poll GET /documents/{id}).
UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse

WeakConceptsResponse.description: The concepts of a document the user keeps missing, weakest first.
WeakConceptsResponse.title: WeakConceptsResponse

get.description: Return all achievements with the user's unlock status and progress.

post.description:
Start a battle (or resume the one already running on this document with the same topic and difficulty).
Returns the boss and the battle_id - never an answer.

get.description:
The battle in progress, if any (on this document when session_id is given, otherwise the latest one):
how a page refresh - or a new tab - finds its fight again.

post.description: Grade an answer on the server and apply the damage. The first answer to a question is final.
Use a heal or 50/50 in this battle. Only items the user owns are consumed.

get.description:
The next question for `move` (strike - the default - | jab | heavy | guard): the move picks the question's
tier and time limit; heavy's Focus is paid now (409 not_enough_focus when short). Options shuffled by the
server, no correct answer, and a server-side deadline. Asking again (refresh, restart) returns the same
question - with the move it was issued for - and the time that is left.

post.description:
Cast a spell on the open question, paid with Focus: insight (two wrong options go) or timewarp (+15 s).
Each works once per question.

get.description:
scope=topic (default): the board for topic + difficulty (+ the document, when session_id is given).
scope=global: this week's board for the difficulty across every topic and document (entries carry the topic).
Each player's best WON battle; rows are written by the server when a battle ends - there is no way to submit
one. `date` is ignored (the boards are no longer daily) and only accepted so older clients keep working.

The run in progress on this document when session_id is given; otherwise the latest active run whose document
can still be loaded (one whose upload expired only if nothing else is left - see run.document_ready), or null.
Best finished run per player by score: on one document (session_id, all time) or global (this week).

post.description: Give up the run (a fight in progress is lost). Pays the run's expedition_complete for the depth reached.

Answer the pending choice: rest (heal | study + target concept), shop (buy + target item id | leave),
relic offer (take + target relic id | skip).

get.description:
The concepts of this document the user keeps missing (arena, quizzes, flashcard reviews), weakest first:
weighted by misses, the current wrong streak and how recent the last miss was.
Return the saved provider settings (never the actual key).

put.description: Validate and replace the user's provider settings.

delete.description:
Delete the account and ALL of its data: login row, chat/quiz history, progression,
leaderboard entries, and uploaded documents (in memory and on disk).

post.description:
End THIS session: its server-side row is deleted, so the old cookie is rejected from now on (401), even
if someone copied it. Works (and just clears the cookie) when the request carries no valid session.
Register a new user, validate their API key, then log them in.
Save hero-forge customization (skin, hair, outfit + equipment)

200.description: Server-Sent Events. `token` events ({"text"}) carry the answer as it is written; the final `sources` event carries {mode, sources, blocked, needs_clarification, rewards}; a failure after the first token arrives as an `error` event in the unified error shape. Failures before the first token are ordinary HTTP errors with the same body.

get.description: The logged-in user's documents, most recently used first.
Status of one document: queued | reading | indexing | ready | failed | needs_reindex.

Liveness: the process is up and answering. Touches nothing else, so a slow database or a model still
downloading can never make an orchestrator restart a healthy process.

post.description: Use a consumable item from inventory. Applies its effect immediately.

get.description:
Public: the provider/model catalogue that drives the signup and settings pickers.
Contains no secrets. (Ollama is included only while ENABLE_OLLAMA is on.)

Readiness: the database answers and the embedding model is loaded - i.e. uploads, chat and quizzes work.
503 until then (the first start downloads the model, which takes a few minutes).

post.description: Unequip an item from a specific equipment slot

Self-graded flashcard review: "I knew it" / "I didn't" counts for the concept's mastery on this document
(what /arena/weak-concepts and a Nemesis are built from).

get.description:
Flashcards made from the questions the user got wrong on this document (arena and quizzes), newest first.
Built from stored data only - no AI call.
